To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MnSOD is upregulated by inflammatory cytokines, saturated, monosaturated and polyunsatured FFA and that this upregulation is observed in visceral adipocytes in obesity.
adipocyte MnSODO is increased in obesity, and that this increase is mediated by proinflammatory cytokines and fatty acids.
MnSOD is upregulated by inflammation, FFA, and HFD in adipocytes and that MnSOD does not affect fat storage or survival of 3T3- L1 cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how oxidative stress is controlled in adipocytes.
the role of MnSOD, a mitochondrial enzyme, in adipocytes and its regulation in obesity.
the regulation of antioxidant mechanisms in obesity and their role in adipocyte function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MnSOD is induced by inflammatory cytokines in adipocytes and that it is elevated in adipose tissue of obese mice and rats.
MnSOD is a stress responsive antioxidant enzyme that is upregulated in adipocytes by inflammatory stimuli, excess triglyceride accumulation and obesity.
adipocyte MnSod expression is upregulated by inflammation and excess fat storage in obesity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MnSOD expression is upregulated by inflammatory stimuli and excess triglycerides in adipose tissue.
MnSOD is upregulated in adipose tissues of HFD fed mice and ob/ob animals, and in 3T L1 cells treated with LPS, IL-1 and FFAs.
MnSOD is a marker for adipocyte oxidative stress in obesity and that MnSOD does not play a role in adipocyte lipid metabolism.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MnSOD is induced in adipocytes by pro-inflammatory mediators and FFA.
MnSOD expression and activity is upregulated by proinflammatory stimuli and excess fat storage in adipose tissue and that MnSOD is a potential therapeutic target in obesity and diabetes.
adipocyte MnSODE may be an important factor in protection of adipocytes from oxidative stress.
